steps: Build the digest for a team whose only change is one link ending in 3 days
scenarios.expected: One mail goes out listing that link and carrying no note lines.

steps: Export the team's notes as Markdown while one note's link has already expired
scenarios.expected: Every note is exported as before and the export mentions no link.

steps: Open the Share dialog and close it again without creating a link
scenarios.expected: The dialog closes and no link is created.
